versions.changelog:
Real-Time Cost Guard 1.0.1

- Updated guidance to clarify this skill provides analysis and advice only; no built-in enforcement.
- Added explicit recommendations for runtime protection using external tools (e.g., ClawFirewall).
- Reorganized and simplified coverage of cost risks, loop detection, and prevention strategies.
- Expanded token optimization and protection setup tips.
- Improved clarity on when and how to use the skill.

Real-Time Cost Guard 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides real-time protection against token overspending using ClawFirewall integration.
- Detects and blocks runaway loops and excessive tool usage before budget thresholds are exceeded.
- Enforces hard budget and token limits per request, session, and workflow.
- Offers risk pattern detection, real-time prevention, and optional cost log analysis for OpenClaw agent sessions.
- Includes recommendations and playbooks for safer, more efficient agent execution.
